meta.name: ui-state-machine
meta.description: Define explicit UI states and transitions for multi-mode desktop workflows. Use for screens with loading/error/editing complexity.

copy.tagline: 定义多模式桌面工作流的UI状态与转换
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在复杂桌面应用中管理多种UI状态
copy.tagline_en: Define UI states and transitions for multi-mode desktop workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple UI states in complex desktop apps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你定义 UI 的各个状态（如加载、错误、编辑）以及状态之间的切换规则，并生成状态枚举和控件启用/禁用矩阵，确保状态切换可预测、可测试。
howto.when: 当你描述一个多模式桌面工作流，涉及加载、错误、编辑等复杂状态时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个表单定义状态机，包括加载、错误和编辑状态。
say.note: Claude 会生成状态枚举和状态转换矩阵。

say.text: 为这个多步骤向导定义状态和转换规则。
say.note: Claude 会输出状态图及无效转换的防护。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you define explicit UI states (e.g., loading, error, editing) and transitions between them, producing a state enum/map and a control enable/disable matrix, making state changes deterministic and testable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a multi-mode desktop workflow involving complex states like loading, error, or editing.

say_en.text: Define a state machine for this form with loading, error, and editing states.
say_en.note: Claude will generate state enum and transition matrix.

say_en.text: Define states and transitions for this multi-step wizard.
say_en.note: Claude will output state diagram with guarded invalid transitions.
